fieldValues.title: First-time writer trying AI-assisted ownership, in Evidence-backed writing
fieldValues.summary: Someone new to the editor, sent a link by someone else, who wants to try being in charge of their own content while still using AI. They have not met records, paragraphs-as-records, problems, counter-claims or paired agents before, and have no one beside them to explain.
goals: Own their own text, in their own words
Use the AI they already have (Claude Code, claude.ai, ChatGPT)
Get started without a guide beside them
jobs: Open the link and start writing
Connect their AI to the essay
Learn the concepts and tools as they need them
Ask their AI to show them how the editor works
fieldValues.needs: The editor explaining itself the first time they open it, connecting their AI explained first, and their AI able to teach them the editor and point at it.
